notes:
v0.3.42 - updating no longer stops at 97%

FIXED: the update could sit at 97% and never move, then give up after three
minutes and tell you to reinstall the companion app. The companion app had
almost always updated perfectly - the page just had no way to tell. It was
asking a part of the companion app that needs a password it does not have, so
the answer never arrived, and the progress bar stayed where it was.

It now asks something it can actually read, and notices the moment the
companion app is back. If it ever does take too long, it says to reload and
press Update again instead of sending you to the installer.

Nothing else changed. This is 0.3.40 with that one fix.
